facts.business: Sutlej Textiles and Industries Limited is an integrated textile manufacturer producing synthetic, natural, mélange, and blended yarns, value-added spun yarns, recycled polyester fibre, and home furnishings.

capacity_or_capex.timeline: As of FY 2025-26: 4.11 lakh spindles, aggregate production capacity of 270 tonnes per day

guidance_or_targets.statement: The home textiles business turned around in the last financial year and is expected to grow attractively
The Company's growth will be driven by the performance of its four product engines - speciality yarns, green fibre, home textiles and technical textiles - coming together

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: No key audit matters to communicate

key_risks: global and domestic demand and supply conditions affecting selling prices
availability of critical materials and their cost
changes in government policies and tax laws
US–Iran conflict adding risk to global outlook
